übersicht

Werde Teil von Greencells – Gestalte die Zukunft der erneuerbaren Energien

Greencells ist einer der führenden EPC-Anbieter im Solarbereich in Europa und kann auf eine erfolgreiche Bilanz bei der Umsetzung groß angelegter Solarprojekte auf dem gesamten Kontinent zurückblicken. Greencells möchte sein Rechtsteam um einen Senior Legal Counsel erweitern, der über fundierte Erfahrung im internationalen Baurecht verfügt und sich insbesondere auf Solar-EPC-Verträge, Projektabwicklung, Schadensfälle und Streitigkeiten in verschiedenen Märkten, darunter der EU, Großbritannien, Irland und anderen Rechtsordnungen, konzentriert. Dies ist eine spannende Gelegenheit, eine Schlüsselrolle bei internationalen Solar-EPC-Projekten zu übernehmen, komplexe Verträge zu verwalten und das weitere Wachstum von Greencells in Europa zu unterstützen.

deine aufgaben

Kernaufgaben

  • Rechtsberatung in den Bereichen Gesellschafts-, Handels-, Vergaberecht, Baurecht und Arbeitsrecht in verschiedenen Rechtsordnungen unter Gewährleistung der Einhaltung geltender Vorschriften
  • Beratung der Geschäftsleitung und des Vorstands zu rechtlichen Risiken und Strategien zu deren Minderung
  • Entwurf, Prüfung und Verhandlung einer breiten Palette von Verträgen, darunter Liefer-, Bau-, Kauf-, Subunternehmer-, EPC- und O&M-Verträge
  • Entwicklung und Pflege von Rechtsvorlagen, Standards und Best Practices
  • Koordination und Steuerung externer Rechtsberater
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Compliance-Rahmenwerken, Richt- und Leitlinien, einschließlich in Bereichen wie Korruptionsbekämpfung, Sanktionen, Geschäftsethik sowie Risikomanagement in Bezug auf Dritte
  • Mitwirkung an internen Compliance-Prozessen, Schulungen und Untersuchungen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Beratern
Schadens- und Streitfallmanagement
  • Unterstützung des Unternehmens bei der Bearbeitung von EPC-bezogenen Schadensfällen und der Streitbeilegung in verschiedenen Rechtsordnungen
  • Beratung zu Streitvermeidung, Vertragsverwaltung und Eskalationsstrategien während der Projektdurchführung
  • Bearbeitung komplexer vertraglicher Fragen wie Verzögerungen, Störungen, Mängel, Abweichungen, Fristverlängerungen, Vertragsstrafen und Zahlungsansprüche
  • Unterstützung der Projektteams beim Schutz vertraglicher Rechte, bei der Erstellung von Mitteilungen und bei der Verwaltung der Anspruchsunterlagen
    Koordination von Gerichts-, Schieds-, Schlichtungs- und Vergleichsverfahren in Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Rechtsberatern
  • Unterstützung des Managements bei der Bewertung rechtlicher Risiken und der Ermittlung wirtschaftlich tragfähiger Strategien zur Streitbeilegung

dein profil

  • Pragmatischer und wirtschaftlich denkender Jurist, der es versteht, die konsequente Vertretung der Unternehmensposition mit einem lösungsorientierten Ansatz in Einklang zu bringen
  • Bietet fundierte, detailorientierte Rechtsberatung unter Berücksichtigung der technischen und wirtschaftlichen Gegebenheiten von Projekten, um die Geschäftsziele effektiv zu unterstützen

The Role

The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for building and maintaining a scalable microservices platform. This role is for the Customer Integrations team and will be responsible for enabling third-party client integrations.

The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise, will partner with Product leaders on building impactful features, collaborate with other tech teams and own projects end-to-end.

This is a remote role based in the United States, with a strong preference for candidates near NYC, Dallas, Austin, Houston, Chicago, Nashville, Miami, or Atlanta. Candidates who live within an hour's commute of our NYC office should expect a hybrid schedule of 2–3 days per week in the office.

Requirements

  • Advanced understanding of SQL, experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases.
  • Familiarity with modern web infrastructure components (e.g. caching, serverless, API gateways, etc) and how to manage them.
  • Understanding of system design, data structures, and algorithms, and experience creating and evaluating technical design documents.
  • Experience with cloud providers such as AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI and managing infrastructure assets using IaC tooling such as Terraform.

Nice to Have

Base Salary

The base salary range is $140,000 - $160,000 annually

Base salary does not include other forms of compensation or benefits. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location and current market data and may vary from the range above.

We are seeking a highly capable Social Media Ads Video Editor to take absolute ownership of the video, motion, and image-based creatives for paid social campaigns. The role involves high-level creation of direct-response ads and high-converting marketing assets using industry-standard editing software. This role is not about basic editing or generic social media posting; it is a specialized position focused on driving commercial growth through data-backed visual storytelling. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with an elite full-funnel digital marketing agency working with premium eCommerce brands across beauty, wellness, health, fashion, jewellery, and consumer products.

Part-time: 20 hours per week
Remote: Fully remote
Engagement Type: Independent Contractor
Monthly Rate: Flexible, depending on experience

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Direct Response Creative Production

    • Design and execute high-performing video ads, slick motion graphics, and static image assets specifically engineered for Meta and TikTok feeds.
    • Apply a refined aesthetic and strong creative taste to ensure all assets align with premium consumer brand positionings.
    • Maintain visual consistency, crisp typography, and high-production polish across every single frame.

  • Creative Strategy & Ideation

    • Develop native-feeling creative concepts, aggressive hooks, angles, and psychological visual triggers tailored to target consumer personas.
    • Produce content specifically localized and optimized to resonate with UK and European-based consumer brands and audiences.
    • Stay continuously ahead of the curve regarding TikTok trends, Meta algorithm preferences, and shifts in digital consumer behavior.

  • Data Analysis & Iteration

    • Review post-campaign creative data and analytics to provide clear, actionable insights into why specific assets underperformed or drove conversions.
    • Contribute to and execute complex creative testing frameworks, iterating rapidly on hooks, messaging matrices, visual formats, and CTAs.
    • Prevent ad fatigue by systematically engineering multiple variations of proven winning concepts.

  • AI Workflow Optimization

    • Seamlessly weave advanced generative AI tools into your daily production workflow to accelerate ideation, speed up asset variation, and elevate editing efficiency.
    • Use AI to scale creative output without compromising on the quality, realism, or premium standards of the final brand assets.

Who You Are:
  • 5+ years of professional experience in video editing, motion design, creative strategy, or paid social creative production.
  • Proven, hands-on experience creating high-converting paid media creatives for consumer product eCommerce brands (specifically beauty, wellness, health, fashion, or jewellery).
  • Expert-level proficiency in traditional editing and motion tools (Adobe Creative Suite, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop) alongside advanced use of creative AI tools.
  • Experience working with UK/European-based brands, companies, or target consumer audiences.
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing, direct-response principles, and how to analyze retention curves or creative metrics.
  • High attention to detail, commercial intelligence, and an eye for high aesthetic standards.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, taking raw briefs and data to deliver exceptional visual execution without constant instruction.

Recruitment Process:
  • Initial Interview
  • Test Assignment
  • Profile Review
  • Client Interview
  • Offer and Onboarding

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Spécialiste en approvisionnement et contrats (bilingue) – JLL

Ce que ce poste implique :

En tant que Spécialiste bilingue en approvisionnement et contrats chez JLL, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs et des cycles de vie des contrats à travers nos opérations américaines et canadiennes. Ce poste est essentiel pour assurer l'intégration harmonieuse des fournisseurs, la conformité et la gestion des risques pour plusieurs portefeuilles clients. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement dynamique et rapide en mode télétravail, soutenant à la fois les comptes établis et les nouvelles mises en œuvre client, tout en servant de liaison clé entre les fournisseurs, les équipes opérationnelles et les parties prenantes internes. Vos compétences bilingues en anglais et en français seront essentielles pour naviguer dans divers environnements réglementaires et établir des partenariats solides au-delà des frontières. Il s'agit d'une excellente opportunité pour un professionnel en approvisionnement qui s'épanouit dans la variété, valorise l'excellence en matière de conformité et souhaite avoir un impact significatif sur les opérations d'approvisionnement de JLL.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien :

  • Gérer les processus d'intégration des fournisseurs de bout en bout, incluant la diligence raisonnable, la documentation et la configuration des systèmes dans Corrigo et autres plateformes clients

  • Superviser le cycle de vie complet des contrats, de la rédaction et négociation jusqu'à l'exécution, l'administration, les modifications et les renouvellements des ententes avec les fournisseurs

  • Assurer la conformité aux exigences corporatives de JLL, spécifiques aux clients et réglementaires, incluant les règlements d'approvisionnement spécifiques au Québec

  • Servir de point de contact principal pour les certificats d'assurance (COI), ISNetworld, Avetta et autres plateformes de gestion des risques; traiter les exceptions COI et surveiller la conformité des renouvellements

  • Communiquer efficacement en anglais et en français avec les fournisseurs, les équipes opérationnelles, les clients et les parties prenantes à travers les régions américaines et canadiennes

  • Coordonner plusieurs initiatives d'approvisionnement et négociations contractuelles simultanées tout en gérant la priorisation à travers divers comptes

  • Collaborer avec les services juridiques et de gestion des risques corporatifs pour assurer que les termes contractuels respectent les normes et faciliter l'approbation des modifications non standard

Qualifications requises :

  • Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, approvisionnement ou domaine connexe, OU expérience équivalente avec 5+ années en gestion de l'approvisionnement et des contrats soutenant l'immobilier, les services d'installations ou l'approvisionnement corporatif

  • Expérience démontrée en intégration de fournisseurs, négociation et administration de contrats avec une solide compréhension des termes commerciaux, de la répartition des risques et des accords de niveau de service

  • Maîtrise de l'anglais et du français (canadien) – à l'écrit et à l'oral – requise pour une communication efficace avec les parties prenantes à travers les opérations américaines et canadiennes

  • Solides compétences interpersonnelles et en communication avec capacité démontrée à influencer les parties prenantes et à bâtir des relations de collaboration

  • Flexibilité et adaptabilité pour travailler avec des exigences clients variées, des structures de comptes diverses et des cycles de projets multiples

Qualifications préférées :

  • Connaissance des processus RFx (DDI/ADP/DAP) incluant la stratégie d'approvisionnement, l'évaluation des fournisseurs et les procédures d'attribution de contrats

  • Maîtrise avancée de la suite MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); expérience avec des plateformes technologiques d'approvisionnement telles que les outils d'e-sourcing, les systèmes de gestion de contrats et les portails fournisseurs

  • Solides compétences en gestion de projet avec capacité à gérer plusieurs initiatives simultanées à travers différents comptes et zones géographiques

  • Connaissance des règlements d'approvisionnement du Québec et du droit des affaires canadien

  • Expérience dans le soutien aux transitions de comptes ou aux nouvelles mises en œuvre client

  • Familiarité avec ISNetworld, Avetta ou des plateformes similaires de conformité des fournisseurs

*Interactions orales et/ou écrites avec des locataires ou partenaires externes basés à l’extérieur du Québec (par exemple, fournisseurs de services, cabinets d’avocats, pairs, banquiers, firmes de courtage, firmes d’analyse de crédit, agences de crédits, clientèle non-francophone, etc.)

Sourcing & Contracts Specialist (Bilingual) – JLL

What this job involves:

As a Bilingual Sourcing & Contracts Specialist at JLL, you'll play a pivotal role in managing supplier relationships and contract lifecycles across our US and Canadian operations. This position is central to ensuring seamless supplier onboarding, compliance, and risk management for multiple client portfolios. You'll work in a dynamic, fast-paced remote environment, supporting both established accounts and new client implementations while serving as a key liaison between suppliers, operations teams, and internal stakeholders. Your bilingual capabilities in English and French will be essential in navigating diverse regulatory environments and building strong partnerships across borders. This is an excellent opportunity for a procurement professional who thrives on variety, values compliance excellence, and wants to make a meaningful impact on JLL's sourcing operations.

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Manage end-to-end supplier onboarding processes including due diligence, documentation, and system setup in Corrigo and other client platforms

  • Oversee the complete contract lifecycle from drafting and negotiation through execution, administration, amendments, and renewals for supplier agreements

  • Ensure compliance with JLL Corporate, client-specific, and regulatory requirements including Québec-specific procurement regulations

  • Serve as primary point of contact for Certificate of Insurance (COI), ISNetworld, Avetta, and other risk management platform inquiries; process COI exceptions and monitor renewal compliance

  • Communicate effectively in both English and French with suppliers, operations teams, clients, and stakeholders across US and Canadian regions

  • Coordinate multiple concurrent sourcing initiatives and contract negotiations while managing prioritization across various accounts

  • Collaborate with Corporate Legal and Risk Management to ensure contractual terms meet standards and facilitate approval of non-standard changes

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or related field, OR equivalent experience with 5+ years in sourcing and contract management supporting real estate, facilities services, or corporate procurement

  • Proven experience with supplier onboarding, contract negotiation, and administration with strong understanding of commercial terms, risk allocation, and service level agreements

  • Fluency in English and French (Canadian) – both written and spoken – required for effective communication with stakeholders across US and Canadian operations

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and build collaborative relationships

  • Flexibility and adaptability to work across varying client requirements, account structures, and project lifecycles

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of RFx processes (RFI/RFP/RFQ) including sourcing strategy, supplier evaluation, and contract award procedures

  • Advanced proficiency in MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); experience with procurement technology platforms such as e-sourcing tools, contract management systems, and supplier portals

  • Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives across different accounts and geographies

  • Knowledge of Québec procurement regulations and Canadian business law

  • Experience supporting account transitions or new client implementations

  • Familiarity with ISNetworld, Avetta, or similar supplier compliance platforms

*Oral and/or written interactions with tenants or external partners based outside Quebec (for example, service providers, law firms, peers, bankers, brokerage firms, credit analysis firms, credit agencies, non-French-speaking clients, etc.)

Estimated compensation for this position:

80,000.00 – 85,000.00 CAD per year

This range represents the estimated base salary and actual compensation may differ. Final base salary is determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations. Some roles and employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses, benefits, or other compensation.


Location:

Remote –Montreal, QC

Opening Type:

Replacement

Sr. Customer Advocacy Manager

At Skillsoft, we believe our customers are our greatest storytellers. We’re seeking a strategic marketer to lead our advocacy program, turning customer outcomes into one of our most powerful assets for sales, marketing, and brand impact. This role centers on customer storytelling, amplifying the voices of thought leaders and practitioners across industries that are transforming their workforces with Skillsoft.

In this exciting senior individual contributor role, you will have the opportunity to partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to identify and elevate customer advocates, build scalable programs, and deliver compelling narratives that demonstrate the impact of Skillsoft’s platform on business performance. This is a high-visibility role with direct influence on the company's next phase of growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Own Skillsoft’s global customer advocacy program, including customer reference, peer reviews and awards.
  • Build and manage a scalable customer reference program, including intake, advocate matching, approval workflows, tracking, governance, and guardrails to protect customer relationships and prevent advocate fatigue.
  • Find, develop, and amplify customer stories that reinforce Skillsoft’s corporate narrative, product value, market differentiation, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Develop strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders and create opportunities for them to share their experiences through case studies, testimonials, videos, peer engagement, events, media, and speaking opportunities.
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to deliver high-impact customer proof that supports strategic deals, accelerates pipeline, strengthens competitive positioning, and deepens customer relationships.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Corporate Marketing, Field Marketing, Events, and Analyst Relations to activate customer stories across campaigns, web, social, analyst briefings, events, and field programs.
  • Establish scalable systems, tools, and reporting to maintain approved customer proof points, track advocacy activity, measure business impact, manage participation, and grow program engagement.
  • Ensure customers receive meaningful value from advocacy opportunities, positioning them as thought leaders while strengthening their partnership with Skillsoft.

Skills & Qualifications Required:

  • 12+ years of experience in customer marketing, advocacy, or reference programs within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology with a Bachelor’s degree or commensurate experience.
  • Skilled at and experience with building trust and relationships with executive-level customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong storyteller experience who can translate outcomes into narratives that resonate with decision-makers.
  • Be a Program-minded marketer who can balance near-term sales needs with long-term brand storytelling.
  • Collaborative partner who thrives at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.
  • Ability to be organized, resourceful, and comfortable managing multiple initiatives at once.
  • Energized by creating two-way advocacy programs that make customers feel celebrated and connected.

Target base salary range for this job requisition is anticipated to be approximately $155,000- $170,000 annualized.

We also offer Enterprise benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, and paid time off

The company may modify salaries, salary ranges and/or Pay Plans from time to time as it deems necessary.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD99564

Position Overview

We’re hiring a Digital Support Intelligent Automation Solutions Engineer to design, build, and iterate on practical technology solutions that improve how Customer Technical Success teams work.

This role is the technical builder behind the Digital Support Technology Transformation Team. You will help turn real operational pain points into working tools and workflows that reduce effort, improve consistency, and create better support experiences for employees and customers. Work may range from lightweight internal web-based prototypes to workflow automations that connect tools such as Airtable, Slack, Slackbots, Salesforce, n8n, Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and other Autodesk-approved platforms.

This is a builder role with a solution-architect mindset. The focus is on solving business problems with the right technical approach, whether that means connecting APIs, connecting to business data in Snowflake, integrating MCP-based services or AI tool connectors, automating a handoff, building a small internal UI, creating an AI-assisted workflow, or prototyping a capability that can later scale through the right platform or engineering team.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand operational pain points and translate requirements into pilot-ready automation solutions

  • Rapidly build POCs to test hypotheses, validate feasibility, and iterate based on measurable success criteria and feedback

  • Build production-aware prototypes with reusability, security, maintainability, and future scale in mind

  • Integrate automation solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, AI tool connectors, MCP-based services, and data sources such as Salesforce Service Cloud or Snowflake

  • Build or integrate lightweight internal tools, including web-based prototypes, Slackbots, and workflow automations

  • Troubleshoot and improve pilot reliability by implementing logging, error handling, and basic observability across workflows and integrations

  • Document technical designs, integration patterns, lessons learned, and handoff requirements for solutions that may transition to platform or engineering teams

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience building automation, integration, or AI-assisted workflow solutions that solve business or operational problems

  • Persistent, proactive builder who is comfortable working through ambiguity, learning unfamiliar systems quickly, and engaging internal experts to unblock progress, understand constraints, and find practical paths forward

  • Proven ability to design and deliver intelligent automation tools, internal applications, or workflow solutions that create measurable business value

  • Experience building Salesforce Service Cloud automations using Salesforce Flow, and integrating Salesforce data into internal tools, workflow automations, or AI-assisted solutions through APIs

  • Hands-on experience building and validating AI-enabled solutions using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, and/or workflow orchestration platforms such as Copilot Studio, n8n, LangGraph, or equivalent tools

  • Experience integrating multiple data or knowledge sources into internal tools, search experiences, Slackbots, or AI-assisted workflows

  • Ability to build lightweight internal UIs for prototypes (e.g., Streamlit, React, TypeScript)

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams

  • API design patterns, authentication flows (OAuth, connected apps), and webhook integrations

  • Understanding data security, identity, entitlements, PII handling, secrets management, and enterprise governance

Preferred Qualification

  • Advanced Power Automate & Power Platform development

  • Ability to troubleshoot end-to-end automations using logs/traces, API error handling, retries, and runbooks for pilots

  • Git-based workflows, basic CI/CD, environment config.

  • Containers (Docker) for quick integrations

  • Event-driven basics (webhooks, queues, retries/idempotency)

  • Knowledge of Power BI for reporting and dashboards

  • Experience with case management or CRM systems (Salesforce Service Cloud ideal)

  • Experience building human-assist support tooling (Examples: Summaries, knowledge suggestions, automated email generation, sentiment analysis, troubleshooting guidance)

raw.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The IT Project Manager is responsible for delivering key technical business initiatives and will play crucial role as the leader of project teams. This role ensures that project goals and scopes are aligned, deliverables and tasks are on time and meet established project standards.

This position reports to the Senior Manager and is part of the IT Program management Office located in Brea (CA) andworking remotely to cover Global Projects.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Lead dynamic project assignments from initial assessment through to completion, by leveraging and coordinating the expertise of diverse disciplines.
  • Craft comprehensive project plans, schedules, and budgets; engage in negotiations with functional managers to secure the right resources and build a team dedicated to achieving project success. Prioritize tasks to ensure productivity, quality, and customer service goals are consistently met.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to clarify requirements, ensuring alignment and understanding as needed.
  • Monitor and track project progress, providing key stakeholders with regular updates to the team to keep them informed of milestones and achievements.
  • Innovatively address and remove obstacles to enhance team productivity and ensure smooth project execution.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience
  • Proven track record of managing complex projects, typically with 7-10 years of IT project management experience in relevant industries.
  • Advanced Project Management Skills: Proficiency in project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Waterfall) and tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, JIRA, PPM Pro).
  • Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and conflict resolution.
  • Strong leadership & stakeholder management skills with the ability to assemble, manage, and motivate diverse project teams to accomplish project objectives.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:if applicable for role

  • 20% Travel will be required to Project sites and Brea CA.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • PMP and Scrum certification.

Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. raw.title: General Manager, Operations | Directeur général, Opérations
raw.excerpt: Role SummaryWe are seeking a hands-on business leader to operate and scale a B2B SaaS business unit serving the clinical trial space.
raw.description:
Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on business leader to operate and scale a B2B SaaS business unit serving the clinical trial space. This role combines full P&L ownership with responsibility for operational excellence, customer delivery, organizational effectiveness, and AI-driven transformation.

The successful candidate is an operator first. They have built and improved systems, streamlined organizations, implemented automation, and driven measurable business outcomes. They are comfortable moving between executive-level decision-making and detailed operational execution.

This leader will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Finance to improve business performance while building a more scalable, AI-enabled operating model.

What You'll Own

Business Performance

  • Own business unit financial performance, including revenue, gross margin, operating costs, and profitability.
  • Develop and execute operating plans that balance customer outcomes and operational efficiency.
  • Refine performance metrics and accountability across functions.

AI & Operational Transformation

  • Lead the adoption of AI and automation across customer-facing and internal workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes, reduce organizational complexity, and increase productivity. • Champion an AI-first mindset across teams.
  • Establish measurable targets for productivity gains and operational leverage.

Customer Delivery & Operations

  • Improve delivery quality, utilization, scalability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Build repeatable processes that reduce dependency on individual contributors.
  • Drive continuous improvement through data, process redesign, and technology.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Align Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Operations around common business goals.
  • Translate strategic priorities into operational execution.
  • Remove bottlenecks and improve organizational effectiveness.
  • Lead business reviews and operating cadences.

Team Development

  • Build high-accountability teams focused on outcomes.
  • Coach managers and develop future leaders.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, transparency, continuous improvement, and experimentation.

What Success Looks Like

Within 12 months, this leader will have:

  • Increased organizational productivity through AI and automation initiatives.
  • Simplified operating processes and reduced complexity across the business.
  • Improved gross margin and operating efficiency.
  • Increased customer retention and delivery effectiveness.
  • Established a scalable operating model capable of supporting future growth.
  • Built a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

This posting is for an existing, open vacancy. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help screen, assess, and/or select applicants during our hiring process; final decisions are reviewed by our hiring team.

— — —

Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un leader d'affaires opérationnel pour gérer et faire croître une unité d'affaires SaaS B2B au service du domaine des essais cliniques. Ce poste combine la pleine responsabilité du compte de résultats (P&L) avec la responsabilité de l'excellence opérationnelle, de la prestation aux clients, de l'efficacité organisationnelle et de la transformation axée sur l'IA.

Le candidat retenu est avant tout un opérateur. Il a conçu et amélioré des systèmes, rationalisé des organisations, mis en œuvre l'automatisation et généré des résultats d'affaires mesurables. Il est à l'aise pour passer de la prise de décision au niveau de la direction à l'exécution opérationnelle détaillée.

Ce leader travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Ingénierie, Services professionnels, Réussite client et Finances afin d'améliorer la performance de l'entreprise tout en bâtissant un modèle d'exploitation plus évolutif et activé par l'IA.

Vos responsabilités

Performance de l'entreprise

  • Assumer la responsabilité de la performance financière de l'unité d'affaires, y compris les revenus, la marge brute, les coûts d'exploitation et la rentabilité.
  • Élaborer et exécuter des plans d'exploitation qui équilibrent les résultats pour les clients et l'efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Affiner les indicateurs de performance et la responsabilisation à l'échelle des fonctions.

IA et transformation opérationnelle

  • Diriger l'adoption de l'IA et de l'automatisation dans les flux de travail destinés aux clients et internes.
  • Repérer les occasions d'éliminer les processus manuels, de réduire la complexité organisationnelle et d'accroître la productivité.
  • Promouvoir une approche axée sur l'IA au sein des équipes.
  • Établir des cibles mesurables de gains de productivité et de levier opérationnel.

Prestation aux clients et opérations

  • Améliorer la qualité de la prestation, le taux d'utilisation, l'évolutivité et la satisfaction de la clientèle.
  • Bâtir des processus reproductibles qui réduisent la dépendance envers les contributeurs individuels.
  • Favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce aux données, à la refonte des processus et à la technologie.

Leadership interfonctionnel

  • Aligner les équipes Produit, Ingénierie, Réussite client, Services professionnels et Opérations sur des objectifs d'affaires communs.
  • Traduire les priorités stratégiques en exécution opérationnelle.
  • Éliminer les obstacles et améliorer l'efficacité organisationnelle.
  • Diriger les revues d'affaires et les cadences d'exploitation.

Développement de l'équipe

  • Bâtir des équipes à haut niveau de responsabilisation, axées sur les résultats.
  • Encadrer les gestionnaires et former les futurs leaders.
  • Cultiver une culture d'appropriation, de transparence, d'amélioration continue et d'expérimentation.

À quoi ressemble la réussite

Au cours des 12 premiers mois, ce leader aura :

  • Accru la productivité organisationnelle grâce aux initiatives d'IA et d'automatisation.
  • Simplifié les processus d'exploitation et réduit la complexité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.
  • Amélioré la marge brute et l'efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Accru la fidélisation de la clientèle et l'efficacité de la prestation.
  • Établi un modèle d'exploitation évolutif capable de soutenir la croissance future.
  • Bâti une culture de responsabilisation, d'appropriation et d'amélioration continue.

Cette offre concerne un poste vacant actuellement à pourvoir. Nous utilisons des outils d'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider au tri, à l'évaluation et/ou à la sélection des candidatures dans le cadre de notre processus d'embauche; les décisions finales sont examinées par notre équipe de recrutement.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 8+ years of leadership experience in software or SaaS businesses.
  • Proven experience leading operational functions such as Professional Services, Customer Operations, Customer Success, Operations, Business Operations, IT, Delivery, or similar.
  • Demonstrated ownership of budgets, business performance metrics, or P&L responsibilities.
  • Experience implementing automation, systems improvements, or AI-enabled workflows.
  • Track record of driving measurable productivity improvements and operational efficiencies.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across technical and business teams.

Preferred

  • Experience in life sciences, clinical research, healthcare technology, regulatory software, or adjacent industries.
  • Experience in private-equity-backed software companies.
  • Familiarity with modern AI tooling, workflow automation platforms, and data-driven operating models.

— — —

Exigences

  • Au moins 8 ans d'expérience en leadership dans des entreprises de logiciels ou de SaaS.
  • Expérience confirmée de la direction de fonctions opérationnelles telles que les services professionnels, les opérations clients, les opérations de réussite client, les opérations d'affaires, les TI, la livraison ou des fonctions semblables.
  • Responsabilité démontrée de budgets, d'indicateurs de performance d'affaires ou d'un compte de résultats (P&L).
  • Expérience de la mise en œuvre de l'automatisation, d'améliorations de systèmes ou de flux de travail activés par l'IA.
  • Bilan probant en matière d'amélioration mesurable de la productivité et de l'efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Solides compétences analytiques et financières.
  • Expérience de la direction d'initiatives interfonctionnelles au sein d'équipes techniques et d'affaires.

Atouts

  • Expérience dans les sciences de la vie, la recherche clinique, les technologies de la santé, les logiciels réglementaires ou des secteurs connexes.
  • Expérience au sein d'entreprises de logiciels détenues par des sociétés de capital-investissement.
  • Connaissance des outils d'IA modernes, des plateformes d'automatisation des flux de travail et des modèles d'exploitation axés sur les données.

ABOUT THE TEAM / À PROPOS DE L'ÉQUIPE

About Anju Software

Anju Software delivers end-to-end solutions for the life sciences industry, supporting clinical trials, medical affairs, and scientific data management with precision, compliance, and operational rigor. Our products help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently.

Anju is part of Valsoft Corporation, a global acquirer and operator of vertical market software businesses. Valsoft invests with a long-term mindset, empowering each company to operate autonomously while benefiting from shared capital and operational expertise.

We are entering a new phase of growth, focused on embedding AI deeply into our systems and workflows. We are excited to add talent who will help lead our transformation into a truly agentic, automation-driven organization that redefines how work gets done in life sciences.

Anju Software, part of Valsoft Corporation, is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

— — —

À propos d'Anju Software

Anju Software offre des solutions de bout en bout pour l'industrie des sciences de la vie, soutenant les essais cliniques, les affaires médicales et la gestion des données scientifiques avec précision, conformité et rigueur opérationnelle. Nos produits aident les entreprises pharmaceutiques, de biotechnologie et de dispositifs médicaux à mettre leurs thérapies sur le marché plus rapidement et plus efficacement.

Anju fait partie de Valsoft Corporation, un acquéreur et exploitant mondial d'entreprises de logiciels de marchés verticaux. Valsoft investit dans une perspective à long terme, permettant à chaque entreprise de fonctionner de façon autonome tout en bénéficiant de capitaux et d'une expertise opérationnelle partagés.

Nous entamons une nouvelle phase de croissance, axée sur l'intégration profonde de l'IA dans nos systèmes et nos flux de travail. Nous sommes ravis d'accueillir des talents qui contribueront à mener notre transformation vers une organisation véritablement agentique et axée sur l'automatisation, qui redéfinit la façon dont le travail s'accomplit dans les sciences de la vie.

Anju Software, une société du groupe Valsoft Corporation, souscrit au principe de l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi et s'engage à maintenir un effectif diversifié et inclusif. Des mesures d'adaptation sont offertes sur demande aux candidats participant à toutes les étapes du processus de sélection. Si vous avez besoin d'une mesure d'adaptation, veuillez nous en informer et nous collaborerons avec vous pour y répondre.

Job Title: Ad Graphic Designer
Location: ''Remote''
Job Type: Full-time

Who We Are:
At STERRY, we’re not your average Growth Marketing Agency—we’re the rocket fuel behind crowdfunding and e-commerce success. Since day one, we’ve helped clients pull in over $100 million in trackable online revenue. We shatter limits, supercharge brands, and turn every click into cash.

Overview:
STERRY is seeking a creative, data-driven, and AI-fluent Ad Graphic Designer to join our marketing team. In this role, you will transform strategic goals into high-impact visual narratives—using AI-generated imagery as a core asset across all layouts, not just an occasional shortcut.

The ideal candidate is a master of visual hierarchy, a meticulous photo editor, and a collaborative thinker who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You will maintain brand consistency while pushing boundaries—and you must be comfortable designing fully with AI when project needs demand it.


What You'll Do:
  • Collaborate with marketing and advertising teams to understand campaign objectives, target audiences, and key messaging.
  • Develop innovative ad concepts for digital and print placements, including social media ads, display ads, email campaigns, banners, and more.
  • Generate, curate, and refine AI-produced images (using tools like Magnific, Adobe Firefly, or similar) and integrate them seamlessly into ad layouts.
  • Create ad designs that align with brand guidelines and resonate with target audiences, ensuring consistent brand identity.
  • Optimize designs for various platforms and ad formats, considering mobile and desktop users to maximize ad performance.
  • Conduct market research and stay current with AI trends and design tools to incorporate fresh, effective elements in our ads.
  • Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute creative ideas to enhance the overall impact of our advertising efforts.
  • Work with the marketing team to A/B test ad designs and use data insights to iterate and improve campaign performance.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality designs.
  • Photo Processing: Edit and enhance raw model photos according to client standards.
  • Creatives Translation (DE/MX/UK/JA): Translate promotional creatives while maintaining design balance and harmony.
  • Perform ad hoc tasks assigned by management from time to time.

What We’re Looking For:
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia Arts, or related field is a plus— but what truly matters is what you can build. A standout portfolio or equivalent hands-on experience is just as valued.
  • Experience: 2–4 years proven experience as a Graphic Designer with a strong portfolio focused on advertising and marketing materials.
  • Technical Proficiency: Mastery of industry-standard graphic design software (Adobe Creative Suite and Canva).
  • AI Tool Integration: Hands-on experience using AI-powered design tools (e.g., Magnific, Adobe Firefly, Canva AI, Gemini, or similar) to generate images and enhance workflows. You must be comfortable designing fully with AI—you can produce final ad assets where the primary visual elements are AI-generated.
  • Learning Mindset: Willingness to continuously learn new AI tools and techniques as the landscape evolves.
  • Analytical Mindset: Ability to interpret campaign data and translate insights into design improvements.
  • Global Perspective: Experience localizing designs for international markets and working with multilingual typography.
  • Organization: Strong time-management skills and ability to handle ad hoc tasks in a dynamic environment.

Why Join STERRY?
  • Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
  • Global Impact: See your designs come to life across major international markets.
  • Growth and development within a collaborative, innovative team.
  • A culture that values creativity, precision, and measurable results.

How to Apply:
Ready to create visuals drive global results? Send us your resume, cover letter, and a link to your portfolio showcasing your best advertising work.

raw.description:
Job Title: Technical Sales Engineer
FLSA Class: Exempt

Learn more about our company and how we support you:

The surgical robot that assists a surgeon. The autonomous vehicle that navigates a warehouse floor. The train control system that keeps thousands of commuters on schedule. Somewhere inside that technology is an ADLINK product.

Ampro ADLINK Technology designs and manufactures embedded computing hardware for industries where failure is not an option. Industrial automation, robotics, autonomous vehicles, healthcare, and intelligent transportation are just some of the markets we serve. Our products sit at the edge of these systems, processing data and providing real-time control where it happens, when it happens, not in a distant cloud.

Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Taiwan, we operate across the US, UK, Singapore, China, Japan, Korea, and Germany with products deployed in more than 40 countries. Our San Jose office drives our business across the Americas and works closely with technology partners, including Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, and NXP.

If you want to work on hardware or software that ships into real-world applications — not prototypes, not demos — and grow alongside a team that has been leading-edge computing for three decades, we want to hear from you.

Whether you are a seasoned engineer or early in your career, what you build here will end up in the real world.


How will you make an impact:
Work closely with the ADLINK sales team on new opportunities and drive solutions to meet customers’ needs which may include carrier designs, semi-custom based ADLINK standard products, and full custom system level solutions. Provide architectural ideas and solutions to meet customers’ requirements. Learn the customers pain points. Lead engineering teams responsible for the design of these products from concept through to production launch. This role also requires strong technical program management skills. The types of designs will vary based on customer, market and company needs but in general can include leading edge next generation x86 processor, ARM based tablets, COM Express, SMARC, and NVIDIA Jetson, carriers, products, or systems.

The Technical Sales Engineer position is remote.

What will you do:
  • Manage new opportunities that require Technical Sales Engineer support through the use of SalesForce.
  • Work with the ADLINK sales team to win custom system level design opportunities which will include travel for onsite customer meetings.
  • Create customer facing presentations and documentation materials specific to technical content. Do not let the Sales team create this content, this is the responsibility of the Technical Sales Engineer.
  • Work with PSM team, when necessary, to support new opportunities that require detailed technical support.
  • Create and provide detailed, customer facing, technical content which will be used in Proposals and Statement of Work (SOW).
  • Strong communication skills including presenting to the customer.
  • Strong Technical Program Management skills required to lead development of projects during the NPI process.
  • Support customers technical requests and issues, drive to root cause, and bring value to our customers by being responsive to their needs.
  • Track and manage ODM/DMS+ projects using Excel for action trackers to ensure project performance and customer expectations are met.
  • Create and manage project schedules (MS Project) to maintain project timelines for ODM/DMS+ and customized projects.
  • Lead hardware design activities from prototype to production phases, driving resolutions for customer reported issues.
  • Help develop NRE, Tooling, and certification plans.
  • Review and identify gaps in BOM Costs by working with internal AATI engineering teams, the Business Unit, and DMS+ as appropriate.
  • In San Jose Office as needed.
  • Help develop NRE, Tooling, and certification plans.
Supervisory Responsibilities:
  • Provide regular management reports detailing team metrics including work loading, schedule tracking, project cost tracking, and others as agreed too.
  • Mentor, train, and nurture junior team members on ADLINK process; correct design techniques and best practices

How will you get here?

Education:

• Minimum of BSEE or equivalent.

Experience:
• Minimum of 10 years related experience.

Knowledge/Skills/Qualifications:
• Demonstrated leadership skills
• Ability to work with customers as well as internal teams
• Demonstrated ability to work with cross functional teams
• Familiarity with high-speed design and debug techniques
• Familiarity with PC architecture
• Must be organized through and possess excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Using a computer
• Using standard SW tools for daily tasks like Word, Excel, Power Point
• Using Engineering tools to view Schematics and PCB Layouts
• Using small tools like screw drivers and plyers
• English speaking with good verbal and written communication skills

Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Life, AD&D, Short Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability insurance
  • 401k retirement plan
  • HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA
  • Vacation and Sick Leave
  • Paid holidays
Physical Demands and Work Environment:
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit; regularly use hands to handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; talk and hear; and doing things such as analytical work or reports, which requires focus, while utilizing a computer.
  • Must be able to operate general office equipment.
  • Physical stamina to stand, reach, bend, lift, grasp, and kneel.
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate.

AAP/EEO Statement: Ampro ADLINK Technology does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factors.

Base Salary Range: $150,000 - $180,000USD Individual offers are based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. This range does not include bonus compensation or benefits, which are outlined during the offer process.

AI-Assisted Screening Notice: As part of our applicant tracking process, ADLINK uses an AI-powered screening tool called Talent Fit to help evaluate candidate applications. This technology assists our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates based on the requirements of the role. All hiring decisions are made by ADLINK personnel, and candidates are encouraged to contact our HR team at recruitment.us@adlinktech.com if they have questions about the screening process.

Applicant Privacy Notice: Ampro ADLINK Technology collects personal information from job applicants as part of the recruiting and hiring process. This includes information you provide directly, such as your name, contact details, work history, and qualifications. We use this information solely to evaluate your application and manage our recruiting process. We do not sell applicant personal information. For questions about how your information is handled, contact us at recruitment.us@adlinktech.com.

California applicants: This notice is provided pursuant to the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).

Fraud & Scam Alert: This is an official ADLINK job posting. ADLINK will never request payment, banking information, or personal financial details at any stage of the recruitment process. If you are selected to move forward, you will be contacted directly by a member of the ADLINK Human Resources team through our Applicant Tracking System, JazzHR or using an official @adlinktech.com email address. If you suspect fraudulent activity or have questions about the authenticity of a job posting or communication, please contact us directly at recruitment.us@adlinktech.com.

Additional information about the role: Please note this job description may not cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. This range may be modified at any time at our sole discretion and does not include additional bonus compensation and benefits. We may consider other candidates for this position with more experience and would expect the salary range to change accordingly. This range may be modified at any time at our sole discretion. raw.description:
Finance Accountant (m/f/x)

Location: Germany/Berlin/Stuttgart

(Remote)

Who You’ll Work For:

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance.

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation.

Who we're looking for:

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Finance Accountants who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you!

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will need to reside in Germany with legal working permits or residence permits.

The role:

  • Invoice Booking:

  • Accurately process supplier invoices in the ERP system, ensuring proper account coding, approval flow, and timely posting.

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation and adhere to internal financial controls.

  • Accounts Payable (AP):

  • Manage payment cycles, monitor due dates, and execute payments on time.

  • Handle vendor inquiries and perform supplier reconciliations.

  • Ensure proper accounting of prepayments and credit notes.

  • Accounts Receivable (AR):

  • Issue customer invoices promptly and in line with contracts, delivery notes, or service agreements.

  • Monitor incoming payments, allocate them correctly, and follow up on overdue accounts.

  • Maintain accurate customer records and perform regular AR reconciliations.

  • Bank Account Management:

  • Perform daily bank reconciliations and monitor cash transactions.

  • Post all bank movements to the general ledger (G/L) and ensure alignment with accounting records.

  • Support cash management and treasury-related activities.

  • General Ledger (G/L) Postings:

  • Book all relevant accounting entries related to AP, AR, banks, and other recurring transactions.

  • Ensure accurate and timely journal entries in accordance with accounting policies and monthly close deadlines.

  • Reconcile G/L accounts regularly and investigate discrepancies.

  • Support Month-End and Year-End Close:

  • Contribute to timely month-end closing, including reconciliations, accruals, and cut-off postings.

  • Assist with audit preparations and provide required supporting documentation.

  • Collaborate with other departments to resolve open items and improve processes.

  • Participate in Finance Projects and Continuous Improvement:

  • Support finance-related projects such as system upgrades, process automation, or internal control enhancements.

  • Collaborate on initiatives to improve the efficiency and quality of financial operations.

  • Contribute ideas and solutions to modernize workflows and reporting.

Requirements

  • Education:

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a comparable qualification.

  • Completed professional accounting certification (e.g., Bilanzbuchhalter/in, CPA) is a plus.

  • Experience:

  • 5–7 years of relevant accounting experience, ideally in a similar operational finance role.

  • Strong knowledge of bookkeeping, AR/AP processes, general ledger accounting, and financial closing procedures.

  • Familiarity with German GAAP (HGB)

  • Excellent Excel skills

  • Skills:

  • Proficient in accounting software (e.g., DATEV, Microsoft Dynamics or similar ERP systems)

  • Accurate, structured, and dependable work approach

  • Effective communication skills in German and English

  • Hands-on attitude

  • Openness to change, and the ability to work independently in a dynamic environment

raw.excerpt: Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent.
raw.description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

The Job

The AI Security Engineer (GRC) serves as the organization's dedicated subject matter expert at the intersection of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity within a regulated healthcare environment. This role is responsible for evaluating AI vendors and technologies, establishing and enforcing secure AI implementation standards, and providing hands-on guidance to development and engineering teams adopting AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Snowflake Cortex, Claude Code, and other large language model (LLM)-powered tooling.

Operating within the HIPAA-regulated landscape, this analyst will ensure AI integrations — including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agentic workflows, command-line interfaces (CLIs), APIs, and third-party AI extensions — are architected and deployed in a manner consistent with NIST AI RMF, HITRUST, and organizational security policies. The role acts as a trusted advisor, security gatekeeper, and enabler for responsible AI adoption across the enterprise.

You Will

1. AIVendor & Technology Evaluation

  • Lead structured security assessments of AI vendors, platforms, and tools prior to organizational adoption or renewal

  • Evaluate vendor data handling practices, model trainingtransparencyanddata residency

  • Assess the security posture of AI platforms including:

  • Microsoft Copilot Studio — plugin trust boundaries, connector authentication, Power Platform DLP policies

  • Azure AI Foundry — model deployment pipelines, private endpoint configuration, managed identity usage

  • Snowflake Cortex — data access controls in AI-generated SQL, Snowpark security, role-based privilege enforcement, Cortex function access policies, and query result exposure risks

  • Claude Code & Anthropic APIs — system prompt injection risks, tool use / agentic permissions, data retention settings

  • GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI-assisted development tools — code telemetry and secret leakage exposure

  • Produce written Vendor Security Assessment Reports (VSARs) including risk ratings, compensating controls, and recommendations

  • Maintain an AI technology registry with risk classifications and review cadence schedules

2. SecureAI Implementation Guidance for Development Teams

  • Serve as the embedded security advisor to software engineering, data science, and clinical informatics teams adopting AI tooling

  • Define and enforce secure-by-default configurations for AI development environments and agentic systems

  • Review and approve MCP server configurations, ensuring:

  • Tool definitions follow least-privilege principles — no excessive file system, network, or shell access

  • Server authentication uses OAuth 2.0 /mTLSand does not rely on static API keys stored in plaintext

  • Transport layer security (TLS 1.2+) is enforced on all MCP server communications

  • Prompt injection attack surfaces areidentifiedand mitigated in tool descriptions and system prompts

  • Logging and audit trails are enabled for all MCP tool invocations touching PHI or sensitive data

  • Establish CLI security standards for AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Azure Developer CLI), including credential hygiene, shell history scrubbing, and token scope minimization

  • Conduct secure code review for AI integration code — with focus on prompt injection, insecure deserialization, and unsafe agentic action chains

  • Develop andmaintaina library of reference architectures, secure configuration templates, and implementation checklists for approved AI platforms

3. AIRisk Management & Compliance

  • Maintainthe organization's AI Risk Register aligned with NIST AI RMF (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage)

  • Ensure AI deploymentscomply withHIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR §164), HITECH Act obligations, and applicable state privacy laws

  • Conduct AI-specific Threat Modeling (STRIDE / PASTA) and red-team exercises targeting:

  • Prompt injection and jailbreak scenarios

  • Indirect prompt injection via external data sources (email, documents, web retrieval)

  • Model inversion and membership inference attacks on fine-tuned healthcare models

  • Data exfiltration through agentic tool chains

  • Track emerging AI threats and threat actor TTPs relevant to healthcare AI systems via MITRE ATLAS and sector ISACs

  • Participate in AI governance committee meetings and contribute AI security perspectives to organizational AI policies

4. SecurityIntegration Reviews

  • Review AI integration architectures for network segmentation, data flow, and trust boundary enforcement

  • Validate that PHI is never transmitted to external AI models without de-identification or explicit BAA coverage

  • Assess retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures for unauthorized data access and embedding extraction risks

  • Evaluate agentic AI workflows and multi-agent orchestration systems for privilege escalation and uncontrolled action chains

  • Provide security sign-off on AI infrastructure as part of the Change Advisory Board (CAB) process

5. Training, Awareness & Policy

  • Develop AI security training curricula for developers, data engineers, clinical staff, and IT personnel

  • Author andmaintainAI security policiesincluding:Acceptable Use of Generative AI, AI Vendor Onboarding Standards, MCP and Agentic System Security Policy, and Sensitive Data Handling in AI Contexts

  • Publish internal guidance and threat intelligence briefings tailored to clinical and technical audiences

Your Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a closely related field
  • Master’s degree preferred; equivalent professional experience considered
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in information security, with a minimum of 2 years focused on AI/ML security or applied AI technology evaluation
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with one or more of the following: Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Claude / Anthropic APIs, OpenAI API, GitHub Copilot, or LLM agentic frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel)
  • Experience working in a HIPAA-regulated environment; healthcare industry background strongly preferred
  • Proven track record conducting vendor risk assessments and producing executive-level risk documentation
  • Deep understanding of LLM attack surface: prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, system prompt extraction, and model manipulation
  • Familiarity with AI red-teaming methodologies and tools (Garak, PyRIT, PromptBench)
  • Knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
  • Understanding of AI model lifecycle risks: training data poisoning, supply chain risks in model registries (Hugging Face, Azure Model Catalog)
  • Ability to audit and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementations including:
  • Reviewing tool definitions and permissions for least-privilege violations
  • Validating authentication mechanisms (no hardcoded credentials, proper token scoping)
  • Assessing stdio vs. SSE transport security implications
  • Identifying SSRF and command injection risks in custom MCP tool implementations
  • Experience securing AI CLIs including credential storage, environment variable exposure, and shell integration risks
  • Knowledge of agentic permission models — understanding when AI agents should require human-in-the-loop approval
  • Ability to evaluate multi-step AI workflow chains for unintended capability escalation
  • Microsoft Copilot Studio: Plugin manifest security review, connector authentication, sensitivity label enforcement
  • Azure AI Foundry: Managed identity configuration, private endpoints, content filtering policy management, model deployment governance
  • Snowflake Cortex: Securing AI-generated SQL and Cortex LLM functions, Snowpark container security, column-level data masking, network policy enforcement, and OAuth integration for service accounts
  • Claude Code: System prompt construction, tool-use permission hardening, CLI credential isolation, API key scoping
  • GitHub Copilot Enterprise: Telemetry settings, suggestion filtering for secrets, IDE extension trust policies
  • Strong grounding in identity and access management — OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, managed identities, workload identity federation
  • API security: authentication schemes, rate limiting, input validation, and output sanitization for AI endpoints
  • Network security: micro-segmentation, private endpoints, WAF configuration for AI service ingress
  • SIEM/SOAR integration for AI audit log ingestion, anomaly detection, and automated response
  • Threat modeling methodologies: STRIDE, PASTA, and application of MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS frameworks
  • Thorough understanding of HIPAA Security Rule requirements and how they apply to AI data processing pipelines
  • Experience with HITRUST CSF controls relevant to AI and cloud-based processing of ePHI
  • Practical knowledge of NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) — Govern, Map, Measure, Manage functions
  • Familiarity with EU AI Act classifications and their implications for healthcare AI systems (high-risk AI designation)
  • Experience reviewing BAAs and DPAs for AI vendor engagements

What's in it for you?

  • Base Pay Range: $125,400 to $215,975

    annually

  • An annual employee bonus program

  • Robust Wellness Program

  • Generous paid-time-off (PTO)

  • 11 paid holidays per year, 1 floating holiday, birthday off, and 2 volunteer days

  • Excellent 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with employer match

  • Robust employee recognition program

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • An opportunity to become part of a team that makes a difference to our members and our community every day!

We're always looking for talented people to join our team! Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply now!

We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects our community through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, inclusive benefits, and more.

  • Articulate design decisions with conviction: why a path was chosen, what alternatives were considered, and what was intentionally left out
  • Demonstrate a high bar for what good looks like — backed by evidence from your portfolio and process

Simplifying Complex Experiences

  • Translate technically complex product concepts into experiences that feel intuitive and effortless
  • Design for both admin and end-user personas — audiences with fundamentally different mental models, workflows, and risk tolerances
  • Reduce cognitive load without reducing capability; make hard things feel easy

Cross-Platform Design Consistency

  • Own and evolve a design system and component library that scales across Windows, Mac, web, and mobile
  • Apply deep knowledge of platform-specific design standards while maintaining a unified PreVeil identity
  • Ensure every surface feels like one product — not four separate apps

End-to-End Execution

  • Drive the full design lifecycle: discovery, user research, wireframing, prototyping, high-fidelity design, and developer-ready handoff
  • Produce clear, complete specs that engineering can act on without ambiguity or back-and-forth
  • Actively use AI tools to accelerate iteration, sharpen craft, and explore ideas faster

User Research & Deep User Understanding

  • Conduct and synthesize user research to build a genuine picture of how users think, work, and struggle
  • Bring evidence of user needs into every design decision — not just instinct
  • Identify behavioral patterns across users and translate them into better product decisions

Collaboration & Reliability

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering — communicate clearly, show work early, and iterate based on real feedback
  • Be the designer people can count on: have great quality designs that are well thought through, meet commitments, and surface issues proactively
  • Work with a low ego and a maker-first mindset — this is a hands-on, high-output role

What We're Looking For

Core requirements

  • 7+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating strong design judgment and enterprise UX depth
  • Experience designing enterprise software — ideally on collaboration or productivity software
  • Demonstrated ability to simplify complex systems into clear, usable experiences
  • Deep knowledge of cross-platform design standards: Windows, Mac, web, and mobile
  • Experience owning and scaling design systems and component libraries
  • Experience designing for different personas (admins and end-users)
  • Fluency in Figma; active use of AI tools to accelerate and sharpen design work
  • Comfort operating independently, with ambiguity and in fast-paced environments, with a strong bias for action
  • Clear, compelling communicator — you can walk any audience through a design decision and make them believe in it
  • Collaborative, reliable, and low-ego — you take direction well and make the team around you better

Nice to have

  • Front-end literacy (HTML, CSS, React) for stronger engineering partnership
  • Experience in fast-paced startup or growth-stage environments

•Strong initiative and bias for action

  • Background designing for technically sophisticated or security-conscious user bases

Working Style & Culture Fit

This role is for someone who leads with craft, thrives with autonomy, and earns trust through consistency and great work product. You'll be joining a team that moves fast — so speed matters — but you'll also be expected to do the rigorous thinking that makes fast decisions hold up over time.

We value:

  • A strong point of view rooted in clear logic, paired with genuine openness to feedback and guidance
  • Work that is thorough and well-considered, not just visually polished
  • Strong ownership and as well as being a strong team player
  • Deep understanding of our product and customers
